kind: analytic ideal-resistive load-line; NOT a simulation

limits.note: BVCEO/BVCBO are DC process-control minima (spec/target-spec.md); a dynamic excursion above them is judged a violation, per the spec. Window = card header of sg13g2_hbt_mod.lib v0.3.0 (npn13G2).

assumptions.load: ideal resistive, optimum for the swing; no output network (D-1 deferred), ideal passives
assumptions.drive: ideal sinusoid, class-A, swing limited by headroom (Vcc - Vknee) and by the window ic limit (peak ic = 3 mA*Nx)

swing_modes.saturated: swing tracks headroom at every tolerance cell
swing_modes.fixed-nominal: swing set at the nominal supply; low-supply cell may bottom

negative.what: Vcc 1.4 V, saturated swing: Vce_pk must exceed BVCEO(min)

positive.what: Vcc 0.5 V, saturated swing: must be within BVCEO/BVCBO (min)
